description: This file defines the LicenceAcceptanceController class in a PHP project, which extends an abstract Vue controller for handling license acceptance within the installer component of OrangeHRM. It includes a method to prepare the view component and set the current installation screen.

classes.name: LicenceAcceptanceController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the license acceptance step in the installer process, extending the abstract installer Vue controller.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by setting up the license acceptance screen component and updating the application state to the license acceptance step.
